svg.title: CoupFE TSV radial stress field
svg.desc: Axisymmetric plane-strain thermoelastic component verification against the declared Lamé equation. It is not a finite-depth 3-D TSV, near-surface device field, experimental validation, keep-out-zone signoff, or transient cooling simulation. The contour is an axisymmetric reconstruction of the recovered sigma rr field.
svg.text: CoupFE newton_solve · Line2 radial mesh · ΔT = −400 K · 2,400 DOFs
Axisymmetric reconstruction, cropped to r = 60 µm (full solved domain: 300 µm)
Axisymmetric component verification · not 3-D · not transient
